egress.terms: Mapillary is 100% free to use—for any use case!

interface_detail: Graph API at graph.mapillary.com (images, map features, detections); upload via mapillary_tools CLI or Desktop Uploader
tooling: `mapillary_tools` (pip), Mapillary Desktop Uploader, official Python SDK, MapillaryJS
chaining: Writes are geographically anchored, so this is a corpus, not a bucket. Read path returns tile/thumb URLs; a normal CDN in front works, but origin fetch is token-gated.
limits_note: per-image: 200 MP resolution ceiling, landscape orientation, EXIF GPS + timestamp required. Read side: graph.mapillary.com 50,000 requests/minute/app; tiles.mapillary.com 50,000 requests/DAY. The forum thread 'Can and does someone replicate the Mapillary images database?' states outright that the free plan's 50,000-image limit blocks bulk re-download.

identity_cost.detail: an account is needed to upload images, use the API, and download data

reliability_note: Uploads are unmetered, while bulk retrieval is rate-limited to 50,000 vector tile requests per day via API.

extras.quota_verbatim: 'unlimited storage' per Mapillary's own blog: 'Mapillary offers unlimited storage and makes imagery publicly available ... any organization, public or private, can store and host their archive of street-level imagery at no cost.' No published per-account byte cap. 2.4 billion images hosted.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-image: 200 MP resolution ceiling, landscape orientation, EXIF GPS + timestamp required. Read side: graph.mapillary.com 50,000 requests/minute/app; tiles.mapillary.com 50,000 requests/DAY. The forum thread 'Can and does someone replicate the Mapillary images database?' states outright that the free plan's 50,000-image limit blocks bulk re-download.
extras.egress_verbatim: free for all use, including commercial, since the Meta acquisition (2020) — but API reads are rate-limited, not byte-metered
extras.chaining_verbatim: Writes are geographically anchored, so this is a corpus, not a bucket. Read path returns tile/thumb URLs; a normal CDN in front works, but origin fetch is token-gated.
extras.identity_verbatim: email — confirmed: graph.mapillary.com with no token returns {"message":"Invalid OAuth 2.0 Access Token","code":190}, and signup is a Meta/Facebook or email account with a free developer token; no affiliation check. help.mapillary.com article 'An Introduction to Mapillary' says 'All you need to start contributing is your smartphone and our mobile app.'
extras.tooling_verbatim: `mapillary_tools` (pip), Mapillary Desktop Uploader, official Python SDK, MapillaryJS
extras.interface_verbatim: Graph API at graph.mapillary.com (images, map features, detections); upload via mapillary_tools CLI or Desktop Uploader
extras.agent_focus: Citizen-science / heritage / crowdsourced-imagery platforms judged on three things: (a) does a quota even exist in the server code, (b) can the ORIGINAL bytes be pulled back out, (c) what identity does signup demand. Plus the relay/P2P half: signalling vs true relaying, and which free relays carry data.

binding_note: calls are bounded rather than bytes, which is fatal to a nightly job on a monthly counter
